# RFC 7529 4.3's examples, transcribed.

# Chinese New Year
RRULE:RSCALE=CHINESE;FREQ=YEARLY
DTSTART:20130210
INSTANCES:20130210,20140131,20150219,20160208,20170128

# Ethiopic 13th Month
RRULE:RSCALE=ETHIOPIC;FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTH=13
DTSTART:20130906
INSTANCES:20130906,20140906,20150906,20160906,20170906

# Hebrew Anniversary Starting in a Leap Month
RRULE:RSCALE=HEBREW;FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=5L;BYMONTHDAY=8;SKIP=FORWARD
DTSTART:20140208
INSTANCES:20140208,20150227,20160217,20170306,20180223

# Gregorian Leap Day with SKIP
RRULE:RSCALE=GREGORIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;SKIP=FORWARD
DTSTART:20120229
INSTANCES:20120229,20130301,20140301,20150301,20160229,20170301

# Gregorian Leap Day without RSCALE
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY
DTSTART:20120229
INSTANCES:20120229,20160229
